Advanced level: the current tunnel checks TCP admission and every outgoing UDP datagram and blocks ping. This session status is not a separate-app bypass test and does not hide VPN presence.
The current tunnel uses Android app routing without additional source validation.

Checks new UDP flows and rechecks on traffic at least once per second. Less overhead; a reused port may remain allowed until the next check.
Checks every outgoing UDP datagram. Detects owner changes sooner; higher latency and CPU usage.

Standard level: the current tunnel checks TCP admission and caches UDP permission for up to 1 second per flow. A reused port may be temporarily accepted. Ping is blocked. This session status is not a separate-app bypass test and does not hide VPN presence.
The current tunnel still uses the previous validation level. Reconnect to apply the selected level.
